title: Calculation Sheet — Returned-Payment Replacement Amount, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Clause.** The returned-payment replacement on the Patient Financial Account is the amount of the most recently returned check or ACH payment plus the returned-payment fee posted with that return, never below 0.00, rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Reading the ledger

| Quantity | Ledger entry |
|---|---|
| most recently returned check or ACH payment | the payment reversal of a check or ACH payment with the latest date; its amount is the amount returned |
| returned-payment fee posted with that return | the returned payment fee charge posted with that return, at the class's returned-payment fee; where the class's fee is 0.00 no fee charge is posted and the fee counts as 0.00 |
| replacement | the two added together, rounded once to the cent |

Card chargebacks are not check or ACH returns and do not enter the replacement.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

1. A check of 215.00 returned on 3 March, with a 30.00 fee posted with the return: the replacement is 215.00 plus 30.00, that is **245.00**.
2. An earlier ACH of 80.00 returned in January and a check of 215.00 returned on 3 March: the most recent return is the 215.00 check, and with its 30.00 fee the replacement is **245.00**.
3. An ACH of 140.00 returned on a class whose returned-payment fee is 0.00: the replacement is **140.00**.
